Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界

The gain matrix and interference-to-signal ratio, asymptotic variance of contrast-based estimators, the optimal nonlinearity, and the Cramér–Rao bound for ICA.

增益矩阵与干扰信号比、基于对比函数的估计量的渐近方差、最优非线性函数，以及 ICA 的 Cramér–Rao 界。

10.1 How accurate can separation be?分离能做到多精确？

An ICA algorithm computes its estimate from a finite sample, so even when the model holds exactly, each output keeps a small amount of the other sources. The script of Section 1.5第 1.5 节 printed WA≈(0.031.00−1.000.02)\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)WA≈(0.03−1.00​1.000.02​): separation succeeded, but the entries 0.030.030.03 and 0.020.020.02 are not zero, and they would change with a new sample. This chapter quantifies such residual errors. How large are they? How do they depend on the sample size TTT, on the distributions of the sources and on the algorithm? Is there a limit that no algorithm can beat?

ICA 算法的估计来自有限样本，所以即使模型完全成立，每个输出里仍会残留少量其他源的成分。Section 1.5第 1.5 节的脚本输出 WA≈(0.031.00−1.000.02)\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)WA≈(0.03−1.00​1.000.02​)：分离成功了，但 0.030.030.03 和 0.020.020.02 这两个元素并不为零，换一组样本它们还会变。本章定量刻画这种残余误差：它有多大？它如何依赖于样本量 TTT、源的分布以及所用的算法？是否存在任何算法都无法突破的极限？

The answers are asymptotic: they describe the leading behaviour of the errors as T→∞T \to \inftyT→∞, and in practice they are accurate already for moderate TTT. Three facts organize the chapter. For the usual estimators the distribution of the errors does not depend on the mixing matrix (Section 10.2第 10.2 节). The errors shrink like 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​, with constants that can be computed in closed form; for one-unit FastICA the constant is the asymptotic variance VgV_gVg​ of Hyvärinen (1997; 1999), and the best nonlinearity is the score function of the source (Section 10.5第 10.5 节). Finally, the Cramér–Rao bound (Tichavský, Koldovský & Oja, 2006) gives the smallest variance that any unbiased estimator can achieve; it is governed by the Fisher information of the sources and becomes infinite when two sources are Gaussian (Section 10.7第 10.7 节).

这些答案都是渐近的：它们描述 T→∞T \to \inftyT→∞ 时误差的主导行为，而实践中 TTT 不太大时就已相当准确。本章围绕三个事实展开。对常用的估计量，误差的分布与混合矩阵无关（Section 10.2第 10.2 节）。误差以 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​ 的速度缩小，其常数可以写成闭式：对单单元 FastICA，这个常数就是 Hyvärinen（1997; 1999）给出的渐近方差 VgV_gVg​，而最优的非线性函数是源的得分函数（Section 10.5第 10.5 节）。最后，Cramér–Rao 界（Tichavský, Koldovský & Oja, 2006）给出任何无偏估计量所能达到的最小方差；它由源的 Fisher 信息决定，两个源都是高斯时变为无穷大（Section 10.7第 10.7 节）。

Throughout the chapter the model is square (m=nm = nm=n, A\bAA invertible), the sources satisfy Assumption 1.1假设 1.1 with zero mean and unit variance, and their densities pip_ipi​ are smooth enough for every expectation below to exist and for differentiation under the integral sign. 10.2 The gain matrix and the interference-to-signal ratio增益矩阵与干扰信号比

Let W^\hat\bWW^ be an estimate of the unmixing matrix computed from TTT samples. Its quality is judged not by W^\hat\bWW^ itself, which depends on the arbitrary scaling of the outputs, but by what it does to the sources.

设 W^\hat\bWW^ 是由 TTT 个样本算出的解混矩阵估计。评价它的好坏，不看 W^\hat\bWW^ 本身（它依赖于输出的任意尺度），而看它对源做了什么。

Definition 10.1 (gain matrix and its error)定义 10.1（增益矩阵及其误差）

The gain matrix of W^\hat\bWW^ is P^=W^A\hat\bP = \hat\bW\bAP^=W^A, so that the outputs are y^=P^s\hat\by = \hat\bP\bsy^​=P^s. The gain error is the matrix ε\bepsilonε with zero diagonal defined by

W^\hat\bWW^ 的增益矩阵是 P^=W^A\hat\bP = \hat\bW\bAP^=W^A，于是输出为 y^=P^s\hat\by = \hat\bP\bsy^​=P^s。把输出排好顺序，使第 iii 个输出估计第 iii 个源，并记 D^=diag⁡(P^11,…,P^nn)\hat\bD = \diag(\hat P_{11}, \dots, \hat P_{nn})D^=diag(P^11​,…,P^nn​)。增益误差是对角元为零的矩阵 ε\bepsilonε，定义为

D^−1P^=I+ε,εij=P^ijP^ii(i≠j).(10.2)\hat\bD^{-1}\hat\bP = \bI + \bepsilon, \qquad \varepsilon_{ij} = \frac{\hat P_{ij}}{\hat P_{ii}} \quad (i \ne j).\tag{10.2}D^−1P^=I+ε,εij​=P^ii​P^ij​​(i=j).(10.2)

Output iii is then P^ii(si+∑j≠iεijsj)\hat P_{ii}\bigl(s_i + \sum_{j \ne i}\varepsilon_{ij}s_j\bigr)P^ii​(si​+∑j=i​εij​sj​): after the unrecoverable scale P^ii\hat P_{ii}P^ii​ has been divided out, εij\varepsilon_{ij}εij​ is the amount of source jjj that leaks into the estimate of source iii. Perfect separation means ε=0\bepsilon = \bzeroε=0.

于是第 iii 个输出等于 P^ii(si+∑j≠iεijsj)\hat P_{ii}\bigl(s_i + \sum_{j \ne i}\varepsilon_{ij}s_j\bigr)P^ii​(si​+∑j=i​εij​sj​)：除掉无法恢复的尺度 P^ii\hat P_{ii}P^ii​ 之后，εij\varepsilon_{ij}εij​ 就是源 jjj 漏进源 iii 的估计中的分量。完全分离意味着 ε=0\bepsilon = \bzeroε=0。

Definition 10.2 (interference-to-signal ratio)定义 10.2（干扰信号比）

The interference-to-signal ratio of source jjj in output iii is ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​], i≠ji \ne ji=j, where the expectation is over the random sample. The total ISR of output iii is ∑j≠iISRij\sum_{j \ne i}\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}∑j=i​ISRij​.

源 jjj 在输出 iii 中的干扰信号比（ISR）定义为 ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​]（i≠ji \ne ji=j），期望对随机样本求取。输出 iii 的总 ISR 为 ∑j≠iISRij\sum_{j \ne i}\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}∑j=i​ISRij​。

Because the sources have unit variance, εij2\varepsilon_{ij}^2εij2​ is the ratio of the power that source jjj contributes to output iii to the power of the wanted source in that output. ISRs are often quoted in decibels, 10log⁡10ISR10\log_{10}\mathrm{ISR}10log10​ISR; the reciprocal is the signal-to-interference ratio (SIR). In a simulation A\bAA is known, so ε\bepsilonε can be computed in every run and the ISR estimated by averaging εij2\varepsilon_{ij}^2εij2​ over runs. For the estimators of this chapter, T εij\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}T​εij​ converges in distribution to a normal law with mean zero and some variance vijv_{ij}vij​, the asymptotic variance. As is customary, we then use ISRij≈vij/T\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \approx v_{ij}/TISRij​≈vij​/T, replacing the exact mean square by its asymptotic value; Section 10.6第 10.6 节 checks this approximation numerically. The constant vijv_{ij}vij​ measures the statistical efficiency of a method independently of TTT.

由于源的方差为一，εij2\varepsilon_{ij}^2εij2​ 就是源 jjj 在输出 iii 中贡献的功率与目标源功率之比。ISR 常以分贝表示，即 10log⁡10ISR10\log_{10}\mathrm{ISR}10log10​ISR；其倒数是信干比（SIR）。做模拟时 A\bAA 已知，因此每次运行都能算出 ε\bepsilonε，再对多次运行的 εij2\varepsilon_{ij}^2εij2​ 求平均即可估计 ISR。对本章讨论的估计量，T εij\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}T​εij​ 依分布收敛到均值为零、方差为某个 vijv_{ij}vij​ 的正态分布，vijv_{ij}vij​ 称为渐近方差。按惯例，我们用 ISRij≈vij/T\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \approx v_{ij}/TISRij​≈vij​/T，即以渐近值代替精确的均方；Section 10.6第 10.6 节用数值方法检验这一近似。常数 vijv_{ij}vij​ 衡量的是方法本身的统计效率，与 TTT 无关。

Why the mixing matrix does not matter为什么混合矩阵无关紧要

Most ICA estimators are defined by equations that involve the data only through the outputs. Maximum likelihood and Infomax solve E^[φ(y)y⊤]=I\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top] = \bIE^[φ(y)y⊤]=I; the fixed points of FastICA satisfy whitening and fixed-point conditions on y\byy; JADE optimizes cumulants of y\byy. Such estimators are equivariant (Cardoso & Laheld, 1996; see also Proposition 7.1命题 7.1), and equivariance has a strong consequence for performance.

大多数 ICA 估计量由一组只通过输出依赖数据的方程定义。最大似然与 Infomax 求解 E^[φ(y)y⊤]=I\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top] = \bIE^[φ(y)y⊤]=I；FastICA 的不动点满足关于 y\byy 的白化条件和不动点条件；JADE 优化的是 y\byy 的累积量。这样的估计量具有等变性（Cardoso & Laheld, 1996；另见Proposition 7.1命题 7.1），而等变性对性能有一个很强的推论。

Proposition 10.3 (performance does not depend on the mixing matrix)命题 10.3（性能与混合矩阵无关）

Suppose W^\hat\bWW^ solves equations H(W^X)=0\mathbf{H}(\hat\bW\bX) = \bzeroH(W^X)=0 that depend on the data matrix X\bXX only through the outputs W^X\hat\bW\bXW^X, and that when several solutions exist, the one returned is chosen by a rule that also depends only on the outputs. Then the gain matrix P^=W^A\hat\bP = \hat\bW\bAP^=W^A obtained from X=AS\bX = \bA\bSX=AS equals the estimate obtained from the sources S\bSS themselves. In particular, the distributions of P^\hat\bPP^, ε\bepsilonε and every ISR are the same for all invertible A\bAA.

设 W^\hat\bWW^ 是方程 H(W^X)=0\mathbf{H}(\hat\bW\bX) = \bzeroH(W^X)=0 的解，这组方程只通过输出 W^X\hat\bW\bXW^X 依赖数据矩阵 X\bXX；若有多个解，则返回哪一个也只由输出决定。那么由 X=AS\bX = \bA\bSX=AS 得到的增益矩阵 P^=W^A\hat\bP = \hat\bW\bAP^=W^A，等于直接用源 S\bSS 算出的估计。特别地，对所有可逆的 A\bAA，P^\hat\bPP^、ε\bepsilonε 以及每个 ISR 的分布都相同。

Proof.证明

Let WS\bW_{\bS}WS​ be the solution returned for the data S\bSS. The matrix WSA−1\bW_{\bS}\bA^{-1}WS​A−1 produces from X=AS\bX = \bA\bSX=AS exactly the same outputs, (WSA−1)(AS)=WSS(\bW_{\bS}\bA^{-1})(\bA\bS) = \bW_{\bS}\bS(WS​A−1)(AS)=WS​S, so it solves the equations for X\bXX and is the one returned. Hence W^(AS)=W^(S) A−1\hat\bW(\bA\bS) = \hat\bW(\bS)\,\bA^{-1}W^(AS)=W^(S)A−1 and P^=W^(S)\hat\bP = \hat\bW(\bS)P^=W^(S), which does not involve A\bAA.

记 WS\bW_{\bS}WS​ 为对数据 S\bSS 返回的解。矩阵 WSA−1\bW_{\bS}\bA^{-1}WS​A−1 作用于 X=AS\bX = \bA\bSX=AS 时给出完全相同的输出，(WSA−1)(AS)=WSS(\bW_{\bS}\bA^{-1})(\bA\bS) = \bW_{\bS}\bS(WS​A−1)(AS)=WS​S，因此它是关于 X\bXX 的方程的解，而且就是被返回的那一个。于是 W^(AS)=W^(S) A−1\hat\bW(\bA\bS) = \hat\bW(\bS)\,\bA^{-1}W^(AS)=W^(S)A−1，从而 P^=W^(S)\hat\bP = \hat\bW(\bS)P^=W^(S)，与 A\bAA 无关。

Simulation studies can therefore take A=I\bA = \bIA=I without loss of generality, and an ill-conditioned mixing matrix does not by itself make an equivariant estimator less accurate. What can depend on A\bAA is the path of an iterative algorithm that is not itself equivariant, such as plain gradient ascent with a fixed step size, and the numerical round-off when A\bAA is nearly singular.

因此，模拟研究可以不失一般性地取 A=I\bA = \bIA=I；混合矩阵病态本身也不会降低等变估计量的精度。可能依赖于 A\bAA 的，是本身不具等变性的迭代算法的收敛路径（例如固定步长的普通梯度上升），以及 A\bAA 接近奇异时的数值舍入误差。

10.3 Amari's performance indexAmari 性能指标

The ISR requires the outputs to be matched to the sources and the scales to be removed. Amari, Cichocki and Yang (1996) proposed a single number that needs no matching of outputs to sources. It does depend on the scales of the outputs, which are therefore normalized first (see the invariance property below). For an n×nn \times nn×n gain matrix P=(pij)\bP = (p_{ij})P=(pij​),

计算 ISR 需要先把输出与源配对，并除去尺度。Amari、Cichocki 和 Yang（1996）提出了一个无需把输出与源配对的单一指标。不过它依赖于输出的尺度，因此要先把输出归一化（见下面的不变性）。对 n×nn \times nn×n 的增益矩阵 P=(pij)\bP = (p_{ij})P=(pij​)，定义

E(P)=∑i=1n(∑j=1n∣pij∣max⁡k∣pik∣−1)+∑j=1n(∑i=1n∣pij∣max⁡k∣pkj∣−1).(10.3)E(\bP) = \sum_{i=1}^n\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^n\frac{|p_{ij}|}{\max_k|p_{ik}|} - 1\Bigr) + \sum_{j=1}^n\Bigl(\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{|p_{ij}|}{\max_k|p_{kj}|} - 1\Bigr).\tag{10.3}E(P)=i=1∑n​(j=1∑n​maxk​∣pik​∣∣pij​∣​−1)+j=1∑n​(i=1∑n​maxk​∣pkj​∣∣pij​∣​−1).(10.3)

Its main properties follow directly from the definition.

它的主要性质可以直接从定义得出。

  • Zero exactly at separation. Each bracket is a sum of ratios in [0,1][0, 1][0,1], one of which equals 111, so it is nonnegative and vanishes exactly when its row (or column) has a single nonzero entry. Hence E(P)≥0E(\bP) \ge 0E(P)≥0, with equality if and only if P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD as in Proposition 1.3命题 1.3.
  • Range. Each bracket is at most n−1n - 1n−1, so 0≤E(P)≤2n(n−1)0 \le E(\bP) \le 2n(n-1)0≤E(P)≤2n(n−1); the normalized index E/(2n(n−1))E/(2n(n-1))E/(2n(n−1)) lies in [0,1][0, 1][0,1].
  • Invariance. EEE is unchanged by permutations of the rows or of the columns. A row bracket is unchanged when its row is rescaled and a column bracket when its column is rescaled, but rescaling a row changes the column brackets. In practice EEE is computed after normalizing every output to unit variance, that is, every row of P^\hat\bPP^ to unit Euclidean norm (the sources having unit variance).
  • Relation to the ISR. With the rows normalized and the outputs matched to the sources, ∣P^ii∣=1+O(∥ε∥2)|\hat P_{ii}| = 1 + O(\|\bepsilon\|^2)∣P^ii​∣=1+O(∥ε∥2) and E(P^)=2∑i≠j∣εij∣+O(∥ε∥2)E(\hat\bP) = 2\sum_{i \ne j}|\varepsilon_{ij}| + O(\|\bepsilon\|^2)E(P^)=2∑i=j​∣εij​∣+O(∥ε∥2). The price of exact decorrelation严格去相关的代价

Many algorithms whiten with the sample covariance and then rotate (symmetric FastICA, JADE). Their outputs are exactly decorrelated in the sample, E^[y^y^⊤]=I\hat\E[\hat\by\hat\by^\top] = \bIE^[y^​y^​⊤]=I, and this constraint alone fixes half of the error.

许多算法先用样本协方差白化、再做旋转（对称 FastICA、JADE）。它们的输出在样本上严格去相关，即 E^[y^y^⊤]=I\hat\E[\hat\by\hat\by^\top] = \bIE^[y^​y^​⊤]=I，而仅这一约束就确定了误差的一半。

从对比函数的角度看，g=G′=ψg = G' = \psig=G′=ψ 意味着在尺度和一个附加二次项的意义下 G=−log⁡pG = -\log pG=−logp：最好的单单元对比函数就是源的负对数密度。单位方差双曲正割分布的得分函数为 π2tanh⁡(πs/2)\frac{\pi}{2}\tanh(\pi s/2)2π​tanh(πs/2)，因此对它而言取 a=π/2a = \pi/2a=π/2 的 tanh⁡(au)\tanh(au)tanh(au) 是最优的；取 a=1a = 1a=1 时方差为 4.434.434.43，而不是 4.284.284.28。拉普拉斯分布的得分函数为 2 sign⁡(s)\sqrt2\,\sign(s)2​sign(s)，aaa 增大时 tanh⁡(au)\tanh(au)tanh(au) 逼近它；数值积分给出 a=1a = 1a=1、101010、303030 时 VgV_gVg​ 分别为 2.012.012.01、1.111.111.11 和 1.041.041.04，逐渐趋于下界 111。对峭度对应的非线性函数 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3，(10.7) 化为 (E[s6]−(E[s4])2)/(E[s4]−3)2(\E[s^6] - (\E[s^4])^2)/(\E[s^4] - 3)^2(E[s6]−(E[s4])2)/(E[s4]−3)2，其中出现了六阶矩；对拉普拉斯分布它是最优值的六倍。这正是Section 5.6第 5.6 节中稳健性论证的渐近形式。由于实践中密度未知，要接近最优，要么采用稳健的通用选择，要么像 EFICA 那样，根据每个成分估计出的分布为它选择相应的非线性函数（Section 10.7第 10.7 节）。

10.6 Checking the theory by simulation用模拟检验理论

The script below estimates T⋅ISRT \cdot \mathrm{ISR}T⋅ISR for one-unit FastICA on a Laplace source mixed with two uniform sources, for g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh and g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3, and compares it with VgV_gVg​ computed by Monte Carlo integration. Every run draws new sources and whitens with the sample covariance; the iteration starts at the true direction, so that the run measures the accuracy of the fixed point near source 1 rather than the chance of converging to another source.

下面的脚本对一个拉普拉斯源与两个均匀源的混合运行单单元 FastICA，分别取 g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh 和 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3，估计 T⋅ISRT \cdot \mathrm{ISR}T⋅ISR，并与用蒙特卡洛积分算出的 VgV_gVg​ 比较。每次运行都重新抽取源，并用样本协方差白化；迭代从真实方向出发，因此测得的是源 1 附近那个不动点的精度，而不是收敛到其他源的概率。

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
nonlin = {"tanh": (np.tanh, lambda u: 1 - np.tanh(u) ** 2),
          "pow3": (lambda u: u ** 3, lambda u: 3 * u ** 2)}
s = rng.laplace(0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), 10**7)     # unit-variance Laplace source

n, T, runs = 3, 5000, 2000
A = rng.normal(size=(n, n))
for name, (g, dg) in nonlin.items():
    # predicted asymptotic variance V_g, expectations by Monte Carlo
    Esg, Edg = np.mean(s * g(s)), np.mean(dg(s))
    V_g = (np.mean(g(s) ** 2) - Esg ** 2) / (Esg - Edg) ** 2
    eps2 = []
    for r in range(runs):
        S = np.vstack([rng.laplace(0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), T),  # target
                       rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), (2, T))])
        X = A @ S
        X -= X.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        d, E = np.linalg.eigh(X @ X.T / T)
        V = E @ np.diag(d ** -0.5) @ E.T            # sample whitening
        Z = V @ X
        w = np.linalg.solve((V @ A).T, np.eye(n)[0])  # start at target
        w /= np.linalg.norm(w)
        for it in range(200):                       # one-unit FastICA
            y = w @ Z
            w_new = Z @ g(y) / T - np.mean(dg(y)) * w
            w_new /= np.linalg.norm(w_new)
            done = 1 - abs(w_new @ w) < 1e-12
            w = w_new
            if done:
                break
        q = w @ V @ A                               # row of gain matrix
        eps2.extend((q[1:] / q[0]) ** 2)
    est = T * np.mean(eps2)
    se = T * np.std(eps2) / np.sqrt(len(eps2))
    print(f"{name}: predicted V_g = {V_g:.2f}, "
          f"observed T*ISR = {est:.2f} +/- {2 * se:.2f}")

The script prints

脚本输出

tanh: predicted V_g = 2.02, observed T*ISR = 2.03 +/- 0.09
pow3: predicted V_g = 6.03, observed T*ISR = 5.74 +/- 0.25

where ±\pm± is two standard errors of the Monte Carlo average (the exact values are Vtanh⁡=2.015V_{\tanh} = 2.015Vtanh​=2.015 and Vu3=6V_{u^3} = 6Vu3​=6). For tanh⁡\tanhtanh prediction and observation agree. For u3u^3u3 the observed value is about 5%5\%5% low, just outside the Monte Carlo interval: the asymptotic formula neglects higher-order terms, and these are larger for u3u^3u3, whose fluctuations are driven by high moments of the source (the denominator involves the sample kurtosis, whose variance involves E[s8]\E[s^8]E[s8], which equals 252025202520 for the unit-variance Laplace law). Figure 10.1图 10.1 repeats the experiment over a range of TTT and for a uniform target. All six curves settle on their predicted constants; the cubic one for the Laplace source does so only for TTT near 10410^4104.

其中 ±\pm± 后面是蒙特卡洛平均的两倍标准误（精确值为 Vtanh⁡=2.015V_{\tanh} = 2.015Vtanh​=2.015 和 Vu3=6V_{u^3} = 6Vu3​=6）。对 tanh⁡\tanhtanh，预测与观测一致。对 u3u^3u3，观测值约低 5%5\%5%，略超出蒙特卡洛区间：渐近公式忽略了高阶项，而对 u3u^3u3 这些项更大，因为它的波动由源的高阶矩驱动（分母涉及样本峭度，其方差又涉及 E[s8]\E[s^8]E[s8]，对单位方差拉普拉斯分布这个值为 252025202520）。Figure 10.1图 10.1在一系列 TTT 上重复了这一实验，并加入以均匀源为目标的情形。六条曲线都稳定到各自的预测常数上；拉普拉斯源配三次函数的那条，要到 TTT 接近 10410^4104 时才做到这一点。

The variances computed so far belong to particular estimators. The Cramér–Rao bound limits all of them. Suppose the source densities are known, so that the unmixing matrix is the only unknown, and parametrize it around the truth as W=(I+E)A−1\bW = (\bI + \mathbf{E})\bA^{-1}W=(I+E)A−1. The gain matrix is then P=I+E\bP = \bI + \mathbf{E}P=I+E: the off-diagonal entries EijE_{ij}Eij​ are the separation errors and the diagonal entries are scale parameters. By the change of variables behind (6.1), one observation has log-density

What the bound says这个界说明了什么

  • Two Gaussian sources. If Ji=Jj=1\mathcal{J}_i = \mathcal{J}_j = 1Ji​=Jj​=1, the block (10.9) is singular and the bound is infinite: the data carry no information about the rotation within the pair, as Section 4.4第 4.4 节 shows from the identifiability side.
  • One Gaussian source. If Jj=1<Ji\mathcal{J}_j = 1 < \mathcal{J}_iJj​=1<Ji​, then CRB(εij)=1/(T(Ji−1))\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ij}) = 1/(T(\mathcal{J}_i - 1))CRB(εij​)=1/(T(Ji​−1)) but CRB(εji)=Ji/(T(Ji−1))>1/T\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ji}) = \mathcal{J}_i/(T(\mathcal{J}_i - 1)) > 1/TCRB(εji​)=Ji​/(T(Ji​−1))>1/T. The non-Gaussian source is located by its non-Gaussianity; the Gaussian output can only be found as the direction uncorrelated with it, and it inherits the sampling error of the covariance (Exercise 10.4习题 10.4).
  • Nearly Gaussian sources. For two sources with the same law the bound is J/(T(J2−1))\mathcal{J}/(T(\mathcal{J}^2 - 1))J/(T(J2−1)). With T=1000T = 1000T=1000 it is 6.7×10−46.7 \times 10^{-4}6.7×10−4 (−31.8-31.8−31.8 dB) for Laplace sources (J=2\mathcal{J} = 2J=2) but 5.4×10−35.4 \times 10^{-3}5.4×10−3 (−22.7-22.7−22.7 dB) for logistic sources (J≈1.097\mathcal{J} \approx 1.097J≈1.097): identifiable is not the same as easy to estimate (Chapter 4第 4 章).
  • Strongly non-Gaussian sources. As Jj→∞\mathcal{J}_j \to \inftyJj​→∞, CRB(εij)→1/(TJi)\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ij}) \to 1/(T\mathcal{J}_i)CRB(εij​)→1/(TJi​) and CRB(εji)→0\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ji}) \to 0CRB(εji​)→0.
  • Bounded sources. A uniform density jumps at the ends of its support, the regularity conditions fail, and the bound is not defined (Tichavský et al., 2006). Smooth densities that approach the uniform law, such as the generalized Gaussian with large exponent in Table 10.2表 10.2, have J→∞\mathcal{J} \to \inftyJ→∞, which correctly suggests that such sources are easy to separate.
  • 两个高斯源。若 Ji=Jj=1\mathcal{J}_i = \mathcal{J}_j = 1Ji​=Jj​=1，则分块 (10.9) 奇异，界为无穷大：数据中没有关于这一对源内部旋转的任何信息，这与Section 4.4第 4.4 节从可辨识性角度得到的结论一致。
  • 一个高斯源。若 Jj=1<Ji\mathcal{J}_j = 1 < \mathcal{J}_iJj​=1<Ji​，则 CRB(εij)=1/(T(Ji−1))\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ij}) = 1/(T(\mathcal{J}_i - 1))CRB(εij​)=1/(T(Ji​−1))，但 CRB(εji)=Ji/(T(Ji−1))>1/T\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ji}) = \mathcal{J}_i/(T(\mathcal{J}_i - 1)) > 1/TCRB(εji​)=Ji​/(T(Ji​−1))>1/T。非高斯源靠它的非高斯性定位；高斯输出只能作为与之不相关的方向来确定，因而继承了协方差的抽样误差（Exercise 10.4习题 10.4）。
  • 接近高斯的源。对同分布的两个源，界为 J/(T(J2−1))\mathcal{J}/(T(\mathcal{J}^2 - 1))J/(T(J2−1))。取 T=1000T = 1000T=1000，拉普拉斯源（J=2\mathcal{J} = 2J=2）的界为 6.7×10−46.7 \times 10^{-4}6.7×10−4（−31.8-31.8−31.8 dB），逻辑斯谛源（J≈1.097\mathcal{J} \approx 1.097J≈1.097）的界却是 5.4×10−35.4 \times 10^{-3}5.4×10−3（−22.7-22.7−22.7 dB）：可辨识并不等于容易估计（Chapter 4第 4 章）。
  • 强非高斯的源。当 Jj→∞\mathcal{J}_j \to \inftyJj​→∞ 时，CRB(εij)→1/(TJi)\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ij}) \to 1/(T\mathcal{J}_i)CRB(εij​)→1/(TJi​)，而 CRB(εji)→0\mathrm{CRB}(\varepsilon_{ji}) \to 0CRB(εji​)→0。

Which estimators attain the bound?哪些估计量能达到这个界？

Maximum likelihood with the true scores does (Corollary 10.6推论 10.6). The densities are unknown in practice, but each off-diagonal score ψi(si)sj\psi_i(s_i)s_jψi​(si​)sj​ is uncorrelated with every zero-mean function of a single source, so perturbing the marginal densities carries no first-order information about EijE_{ij}Eij​; this is why the same bound remains the benchmark when the densities must be learned from the data (see Amari & Cardoso, 1997, for the semiparametric theory of ICA estimating functions). Other estimators fall short of the bound, for reasons that can be identified.

用真实得分函数的最大似然可以达到（Corollary 10.6推论 10.6）。实践中密度是未知的；但每个非对角得分 ψi(si)sj\psi_i(s_i)s_jψi​(si​)sj​ 都与任何只依赖单个源的零均值函数不相关，因此扰动边缘密度不会带来关于 EijE_{ij}Eij​ 的一阶信息；这就是为什么密度需要从数据中学习时，这个界仍然是衡量标准（ICA 估计函数的半参数理论见 Amari & Cardoso, 1997）。其他估计量达不到这个界，而原因都可以说清楚。

A one-unit contrast looks only at the distribution of its own output and ignores the non-Gaussianity of the interfering sources, which maximum likelihood exploits. Estimators with exactly decorrelated outputs pay a different price. By Proposition 10.7命题 10.7, T(εij+εji)\sqrt{T}(\varepsilon_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ji})T​(εij​+εji​) is asymptotically N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1), so to first order the sum has variance 1/T1/T1/T, while the bound for the variance of the sum, (1,1) Fij−1(1,1)⊤/T(1, 1)\,\mathbf{F}_{ij}^{-1}(1, 1)^\top/T(1,1)Fij−1​(1,1)⊤/T, equals

since the difference of the two sides is proportional to (Ji−1)(Jj−1)≥0(\mathcal{J}_i - 1)(\mathcal{J}_j - 1) \ge 0(Ji​−1)(Jj​−1)≥0, with equality only when one of the sources is Gaussian. Hence no estimator with exactly decorrelated outputs is asymptotically efficient for a pair of non-Gaussian sources; this limitation of prewhitened (orthogonal) methods was analysed by Cardoso (1994). Symmetric FastICA (Algorithm 8.6算法 8.6) has both limitations, since it applies one nonlinearity ggg to all outputs and decorrelates them exactly. Tichavský, Koldovský and Oja (2006) derived its asymptotic accuracy (the result is restated as eq. (10) of Koldovský, Tichavský & Oja, 2006): for k≠lk \ne lk=l,

因为两边之差与 (Ji−1)(Jj−1)≥0(\mathcal{J}_i - 1)(\mathcal{J}_j - 1) \ge 0(Ji​−1)(Jj​−1)≥0 成正比，只有当其中一个源是高斯时才取等号。因此，对一对非高斯源，输出严格去相关的估计量都不是渐近有效的；Cardoso（1994）分析过预白化（正交）方法的这一局限。对称 FastICA（Algorithm 8.6算法 8.6）同时具有这两种局限：它对所有输出使用同一个非线性函数 ggg，并使输出严格去相关。Tichavský、Koldovský 和 Oja（2006）推导了它的渐近精度（Koldovský, Tichavský & Oja, 2006 的式 (10) 重述了这一结果）：对 k≠lk \ne lk=l，

T⋅ISRkl → γk+γl+τl2(τk+τl)2,γk=βk−μk2,τk=∣μk−ρk∣,(10.11)T\cdot\mathrm{ISR}_{kl} \ \to\ \frac{\gamma_k + \gamma_l + \tau_l^2}{(\tau_k + \tau_l)^2}, \qquad \gamma_k = \beta_k - \mu_k^2, \quad \tau_k = |\mu_k - \rho_k|,\tag{10.11}T⋅ISRkl​ → (τk​+τl​)2γk​+γl​+τl2​​,γk​=βk​−μk2​,τk​=∣μk​−ρk​∣,(10.11)

with μk=E[skg(sk)]\mu_k = \E[s_kg(s_k)]μk​=E[sk​g(sk​)], ρk=E[g′(sk)]\rho_k = \E[g'(s_k)]ρk​=E[g′(sk​)] and βk=E[g2(sk)]\beta_k = \E[g^2(s_k)]βk​=E[g2(sk​)]. For two Laplace sources and g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh this is 1.261.261.26, compared with 2.012.012.01 for the one-unit estimator and the bound 0.670.670.67. Exercise 10.5习题 10.5 derives (10.11) by linearizing the fixed-point conditions in the way of Proposition 10.5命题 10.5. Like (10.7), it assumes that the data are not centered with the sample mean, or that E[g(sk)]=E[g(sl)]=0\E[g(s_k)] = \E[g(s_l)] = 0E[g(sk​)]=E[g(sl​)]=0; with centering, its numerator loses (E[g(sk)])2+(E[g(sl)])2(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2(E[g(sk​)])2+(E[g(sl​)])2 (Wei, 2015). EFICA (Koldovský, Tichavský & Oja, 2006) is designed to remove both limitations: it starts from symmetric FastICA, chooses for each component a nonlinearity adapted to its estimated distribution, and refines the estimate. Its authors proved that it is asymptotically efficient, attaining the Cramér–Rao bound, for generalized Gaussian sources with α>2\alpha > 2α>2, for which the nonlinearity it selects is the score function of the source, with the exponent estimated from the data. For super-Gaussian generalized Gaussian sources with 1≤α<21 \le \alpha < 21≤α<2 its accuracy is close to the bound without attaining it, and for smaller α\alphaα it is no longer close.

其中 μk=E[skg(sk)]\mu_k = \E[s_kg(s_k)]μk​=E[sk​g(sk​)]，ρk=E[g′(sk)]\rho_k = \E[g'(s_k)]ρk​=E[g′(sk​)]，βk=E[g2(sk)]\beta_k = \E[g^2(s_k)]βk​=E[g2(sk​)]。对两个拉普拉斯源并取 g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh，该值为 1.261.261.26，而单单元估计量为 2.012.012.01，界为 0.670.670.67。Exercise 10.5习题 10.5按Proposition 10.5命题 10.5的方式把不动点条件线性化，推导出了 (10.11)。与 (10.7) 一样，它假设数据没有按样本均值中心化，或者 E[g(sk)]=E[g(sl)]=0\E[g(s_k)] = \E[g(s_l)] = 0E[g(sk​)]=E[g(sl​)]=0；做中心化时，其分子要减去 (E[g(sk)])2+(E[g(sl)])2(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2(E[g(sk​)])2+(E[g(sl​)])2（Wei, 2015）。EFICA（Koldovský, Tichavský & Oja, 2006）旨在消除这两种局限：它从对称 FastICA 出发，根据每个成分估计出的分布为它选择相应的非线性函数，再对估计作精化。作者证明，对 α>2\alpha > 2α>2 的广义高斯源，EFICA 选出的非线性函数就是源的得分函数（其中的指数由数据估计），因而它渐近有效、达到 Cramér–Rao 界。对 1≤α<21 \le \alpha < 21≤α<2 的超高斯广义高斯源，其精度接近这个界但达不到它；α\alphaα 更小时则已不再接近。

Key points

本章要点

  • The gain error εij=P^ij/P^ii\varepsilon_{ij} = \hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}εij​=P^ij​/P^ii​ measures how much of source jjj leaks into the estimate of source iii; ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​]. Once the outputs are normalized, Amari's index summarizes P^\hat\bPP^ without matching outputs to sources; it decreases like 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​.
  • For equivariant estimators the distribution of the errors does not depend on the mixing matrix, only on the sources and the method.
  • Estimators defined by estimating equations have errors of order 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​; for ICA the asymptotic variance decouples into pairs of sources, and exact decorrelation makes T(εij+εji)\sqrt{T}(\varepsilon_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ji})T​(εij​+εji​) asymptotically N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1).
  • One-unit FastICA has asymptotic variance VgV_gVg​, which depends only on the estimated source (and, for skewed sources, on whether the data are centered); it is minimized by the score function, with value 1/(J−1)1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)1/(J−1).
  • The Cramér–Rao bound is Jj/(T(JiJj−1))\mathcal{J}_j/(T(\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j - 1))Jj​/(T(Ji​Jj​−1)): infinite for two Gaussian sources, large for nearly Gaussian ones, attained by maximum likelihood with the true scores, and in general not attained by one-unit or exactly decorrelating estimators.
  • 增益误差 εij=P^ij/P^ii\varepsilon_{ij} = \hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}εij​=P^ij​/P^ii​ 衡量源 jjj 漏进源 iii 的估计中的多少；ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​]。把输出归一化之后，Amari 指标无需把输出与源配对就能概括 P^\hat\bPP^，并以 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​ 的速度下降。
  • 对等变估计量，误差的分布与混合矩阵无关，只取决于源和方法。
  • 由估计方程定义的估计量误差为 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​ 量级；在 ICA 中渐近方差按源的两两配对解耦，而严格去相关使 T(εij+εji)\sqrt{T}(\varepsilon_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ji})T​(εij​+εji​) 渐近服从 N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1)。
  • 单单元 FastICA 的渐近方差为 VgV_gVg​，它只依赖于被估计的源（对偏斜的源，还取决于数据是否做了中心化）；得分函数使它达到最小值 1/(J−1)1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)1/(J−1)。
  • Cramér–Rao 界为 Jj/(T(JiJj−1))\mathcal{J}_j/(T(\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j - 1))Jj​/(T(Ji​Jj​−1))：两个源都是高斯时为无穷大，源接近高斯时很大；用真实得分函数的最大似然可以达到它，单单元估计量和严格去相关的估计量一般达不到。

Therefore TVar⁡(ekl)→(γk+γl+τl2)/(τk+τl)2T\Var(e_{kl}) \to (\gamma_k + \gamma_l + \tau_l^2)/(\tau_k + \tau_l)^2TVar(ekl​)→(γk​+γl​+τl2​)/(τk​+τl​)2, and εkl=ekl+Op(T−1)\varepsilon_{kl} = e_{kl} + O_p(T^{-1})εkl​=ekl​+Op​(T−1). If the data are first centered with the sample mean, s\bss is replaced by s−sˉ\bs - \bar\bss−sˉ. To first order this subtracts sˉl E[gk(sk)]\bar s_l\,\E[g_k(s_k)]sˉl​E[gk​(sk​)] from uklu_{kl}ukl​ and sˉk E[gl(sl)]\bar s_k\,\E[g_l(s_l)]sˉk​E[gl​(sl​)] from ulku_{lk}ulk​, so in the two averages gk(sk)g_k(s_k)gk​(sk​) and gl(sl)g_l(s_l)gl​(sl​) are replaced by their deviations from their means. The averages remain uncorrelated, γk\gamma_kγk​ becomes γk−(E[g(sk)])2\gamma_k - (\E[g(s_k)])^2γk​−(E[g(sk​)])2, γl+τl2\gamma_l + \tau_l^2γl​+τl2​ becomes γl+τl2−(E[g(sl)])2\gamma_l + \tau_l^2 - (\E[g(s_l)])^2γl​+τl2​−(E[g(sl​)])2, and the numerator loses (E[g(sk)])2+(E[g(sl)])2(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2(E[g(sk​)])2+(E[g(sl​)])2.

这两个平均不相关，因为它们的协方差乘以 TTT 等于 E[sk(gk(sk)−μk′sk)] E[sl(gl(sl)−ρl′sl)]=0⋅(μl′−ρl′)=0\E[s_k(g_k(s_k) - \mu'_ks_k)]\,\E[s_l(g_l(s_l) - \rho'_ls_l)] = 0 \cdot (\mu'_l - \rho'_l) = 0E[sk​(gk​(sk​)−μk′​sk​)]E[sl​(gl​(sl​)−ρl′​sl​)]=0⋅(μl′​−ρl′​)=0。它们的方差乘以 TTT 分别为 E[(gk(sk)−μk′sk)2]=βk−μk2=γk\E[(g_k(s_k) - \mu'_ks_k)^2] = \beta_k - \mu_k^2 = \gamma_kE[(gk​(sk​)−μk′​sk​)2]=βk​−μk2​=γk​ 和 E[(gl(sl)−ρl′sl)2]=βl−2ρl′μl′+ρl′2=γl+τl2\E[(g_l(s_l) - \rho'_ls_l)^2] = \beta_l - 2\rho'_l\mu'_l + \rho_l'^2 = \gamma_l + \tau_l^2E[(gl​(sl​)−ρl′​sl​)2]=βl​−2ρl′​μl′​+ρl′2​=γl​+τl2​。因此 TVar⁡(ekl)→(γk+γl+τl2)/(τk+τl)2T\Var(e_{kl}) \to (\gamma_k + \gamma_l + \tau_l^2)/(\tau_k + \tau_l)^2TVar(ekl​)→(γk​+γl​+τl2​)/(τk​+τl​)2，而 εkl=ekl+Op(T−1)\varepsilon_{kl} = e_{kl} + O_p(T^{-1})εkl​=ekl​+Op​(T−1)。若先用样本均值把数据中心化，就要把 s\bss 换成 s−sˉ\bs - \bar\bss−sˉ。在一阶近似下，这使 uklu_{kl}ukl​ 减去 sˉl E[gk(sk)]\bar s_l\,\E[g_k(s_k)]sˉl​E[gk​(sk​)]，ulku_{lk}ulk​ 减去 sˉk E[gl(sl)]\bar s_k\,\E[g_l(s_l)]sˉk​E[gl​(sl​)]，相当于在两个平均中把 gk(sk)g_k(s_k)gk​(sk​) 和 gl(sl)g_l(s_l)gl​(sl​) 换成它们与各自均值之差。两个平均仍不相关，γk\gamma_kγk​ 变为 γk−(E[g(sk)])2\gamma_k - (\E[g(s_k)])^2γk​−(E[g(sk​)])2，γl+τl2\gamma_l + \tau_l^2γl​+τl2​ 变为 γl+τl2−(E[g(sl)])2\gamma_l + \tau_l^2 - (\E[g(s_l)])^2γl​+τl2​−(E[g(sl​)])2，所以分子减少 (E[g(sk)])2+(E[g(sl)])2(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2(E[g(sk​)])2+(E[g(sl​)])2。
